description: Seagate is a leading provider of mass-capacity data storage, accelerating the world's ability to harness the full value of data, and for nearly 50 years its portfolio of advanced storage solutions has helped hyperscale, cloud service providers, enterprises and consumers protect, create and manage the data that powers their transformation and growth. Hard disk drives remain a foundational technology for delivering scalable, energy-efficient, mass-capacity storage with favorable storage economics that underpins modern digital infrastructure, and its vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing capabilities, together with continued investment in advanced storage technologies, position it to address customers' evolving storage requirements. It designs and manufactures HDDs, storage systems and related solutions serving two principal end markets, Data Center, which comprises cloud and enterprise environments that rely on scalable, high-capacity storage infrastructure to support AI-enabled computing, business-critical applications and other data-intensive workloads, and other markets.
company_name: Seagate Technology Holdings Public Limited Company
